responses.raw:
VERDICT: VALID
REASON: "Avions corrigé" is the correct plus-que-parfait (pluperfect) conjugation of "corriger" for "nous". This tense is appropriately used here to indicate an action that happened before the past narrative context ("Tu me racontais..." - You were telling me...), making "Tu me racontais que nous avions corrigé les erreurs avant la présentation" (You were telling me that we had corrected the errors before the presentation) grammatically sound French.
